source: lab (captured; background blurred/replaced by 'Segment Anything 2 Demo' - watermark bottom-right x>1030,y>690)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame 0 at t=0; container pts are uniform (512 ticks/frame)

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift vs frame 0 < 0.15 px at frames 12,24,36,48)
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg, f = 0.5959*1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640,360)

perspective.note: table-top left edge x = -1.573*y + 1102.5, right edge x = 1.782*y - 40.5 (frame 48); they converge at (567,341). Camera looks along the table, slightly down (horizon ~19 px above principal point).

objects.name: ball
objects.description: small white ball (only white sphere in scene); held by a hand at the back-left of the table top, pushed/released, rolls diagonally toward the camera and to the right, leaves the table over the front-right edge, falls and exits the image bottom
objects.visible_frames: 0-39 fully (0-12 partly covered by blurred hand), 40 sliver at image bottom behind watermark, absent 41-48

apparent_diameter_px.note: vertical extent (diam_v_px) is the blur-free diameter while rolling; horizontal includes motion blur. Size roughly doubles 0->35: ball approaches camera (depth roughly halves)

objects.name: hand
objects.description: blurred skin-coloured hand at back-left of the table (x~380-410,y~410-445) holding the ball; ball drifts ~6 px left during frames 4-10 while held, then pushed right at frame 12-13; hand withdraws/blurs out after

objects.name: table
objects.description: rectangular wooden table top (light brown wood grain) in the centre-bottom, long axis pointing away from camera, dark front edge face, single pedestal leg

objects.name: chair
objects.description: blurred chair back (dark arch) just behind the back-left part of the table, x~430-520, y~395-445; slight change in this blurred area at frames 41-48 (background layer, not a measurable motion)

objects.name: tripod_light_stand
objects.description: blurred tripod stand with blue light on top behind the table, centre x~690, top y~65, legs down to y~440

objects.name: person_legs
objects.description: blurred jeans of a seated person under/behind the table, y>630, x~300-650

objects.name: tv_screen
objects.description: black screen/monitor top-right corner, x~1010-1280, y~0-130

events.event: ball drifts slowly left in hand (~6 px)

events.note: first displacement 11->12 (+3.5 px), clear motion from 13 (t=0.542)

events.event: ball reaches front-right table edge / leaves table
events.note: large image jump 35->36 (~73 px vs ~29 px per frame before) - possibly a capture irregularity; centre at the right edge line at frame 36
